name: Artbees Wishlist for WooCommerce
author: artbees

sections.description:
Artbees Wishlist is a modern WooCommerce wishlist plugin built for fast saving, flexible store layouts, and a complete Free experience.

Logged-in customers can create and manage unlimited named wishlists. Guests can save products to one temporary wishlist in the current browser, and compatible guest items can merge into the customer’s account after login or registration.

Wishlist experience

  • Unlimited named wishlists for logged-in customers.
  • One temporary guest wishlist with configurable retention.
  • Wishlist buttons on product pages and product/archive cards.
  • Fast side drawer after save actions.
  • Wishlist page with per-item and bulk add-to-cart actions.
  • My Account wishlist access.
  • Product- and variation-aware saving and cart actions.
  • Private/shareable list state with opaque, revocable share links.
  • Shared-list visitors can add visible products to cart.
  • Mobile-first wishlist layouts.

Built for modern WooCommerce sites

  • Wishlist page block plus shortcode fallback.
  • Gutenberg and WooCommerce Blocks support.
  • Elementor widgets for wishlist buttons, counter/drawer trigger, and wishlist page/list.
  • Jupiter X-compatible wishlist surfaces.
  • Standard WooCommerce hooks and integration points for classic themes and custom layouts.
  • Cache-safe asynchronous saved-state and counter hydration.

Style controls included

The Free plugin includes a focused Style tab for the wishlist button, including:

  • Live button preview.
  • Product-page and shop-loop labels.
  • Product-page and archive placement.
  • Icon visibility and position.
  • Full-width and minimum-height controls.
  • Padding and margin.
  • Font size, weight, and text transform.
  • Border width and radius.
  • Normal, hover, saved, and disabled colors.
  • Reset to defaults.

Move from YITH Wishlist

A same-site YITH Wishlist importer is included for stores moving existing wishlist data into Artbees Wishlist. The importer previews the migration before changing data and includes progress, logs, skip reporting, and retry-safe behavior.

Migration is based on existing product and variation IDs on the same WooCommerce store. It is not a cross-store product-matching tool.

Privacy-aware by design

Artbees Wishlist includes WordPress privacy export/erase support, guest-data retention cleanup, and revocable sharing.

Learn more, view documentation, and see Free vs Pro:
Artbees Wishlist for WooCommerce

Video overview

Optional Pro add-on

Artbees Wishlist Pro is distributed separately and adds advanced list and item management, product notes, quantities, move/copy and manual sorting, advanced sharing controls, analytics and conversion reports, CSV export, out-of-stock demand reporting, price-drop alerts, back-in-stock alerts, structured alert email editing, email logs, consent/unsubscribe controls, and optional WooCommerce coupon incentives inside the supported alert emails.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Artbees Wishlist for WooCommerce.
  3. Open the Artbees Wishlist workspace in WordPress admin.
  4. Create or assign the wishlist page.
  5. Configure the product/archive buttons, side drawer, guest retention, sharing, and styling as needed.
  6. If you are migrating from YITH Wishlist on the same store, preview the import before running it.
sections.faq:
Can logged-in customers create multiple wishlists in the Free plugin?

Yes. Logged-in customers can create and manage unlimited named wishlists in Free.

What happens for guest shoppers?

Guests use one temporary wishlist in the current browser. Guest retention is configurable, and compatible guest items can merge into the customer’s account after login or registration.

Does it work with the block editor and Elementor?

Yes. Artbees Wishlist includes block-compatible wishlist surfaces, Elementor widgets, Jupiter X-compatible surfaces, shortcode fallback, and standard WooCommerce integration hooks.

Can I migrate from YITH Wishlist?

Yes, for same-site migration. The importer previews the migration first and works with existing product and variation IDs on the same WooCommerce store.

Can customers share wishlists?

Yes. Free includes shareable lists using opaque, revocable share links.

Does the Free plugin send price-drop or back-in-stock emails?

No. Wishlist notification emails are not part of Free. Price-drop and back-in-stock alert workflows are provided by the separately distributed Pro add-on.

What privacy tools are included?

Free includes WordPress privacy export/erase support, guest-data retention cleanup, and share-link revocation.

  • Added contextual setup and settings help with links to the published knowledge base.
  • Added a getting-started checklist that collapses after setup objectives are complete.
  • Added a lightweight review prompt after meaningful wishlist activity, with snooze and dismiss actions.
  • Added a subtle persistent admin footer for documentation, support, and review collection.

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
